prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: single production reference for a 128x128 pixel-art side-scrolling RPG enemy. Input image is STYLE ONLY: match the barbarian's crisp dark outlines, carefully grouped pixels, rich but controlled 3-4 tone material shading, readable volumetric anatomy and equal finish. Do not borrow human anatomy, clothing, blond hair or club. Draw ONE isolated full-body enemy facing LEFT in strict lateral profile, fixed side camera. Detailed 128px sprite aesthetic, not smooth painting, not coarse polygons, not photorealism, no dithering or noisy speckles. Light from upper-left. Every limb fully visible within ample padding. Background must be uniform solid blue-gray #8b9bb4 for color-key extraction. Do not imitate the reference's checkerboard. No ground, cast shadow, scenery, text, labels or frame. Reference standing/resting pose. Preserve subject identity exactly.
Subject: A swollen human cadaver with distended belly, thick limbs, low head between raised shoulders. Cold mottled gray waxy skin, green joints, purple neck shadows. Puffy slack face, BOTH EYES MISSING: black empty sockets, no pupils, eyeballs or glow. Sparse wet dark hair and duckweed. Sodden coarse brown-stained shirt stretched tight and split at lower belly seams, frayed waterlogged trousers, ruined leather boots splitting around swollen feet. Weed strands on cuffs. Loose arms hang away from thick torso, curled fingers. No weapons or armor.
